scope: 内容生成扩展回归；测试直接运行产品匹配、本地知识库、预算快照和发布核验实现。

scenarios.expected: 两款型号 × 三个平台均生成 ready_for_review、六项核验无 fail、安全版本可用
scenarios.covered_by: normal input covers the complete 2 models x 3 platforms matrix

scenarios.expected: 关键场景/产品类型缺失时返回 needs_clarification，不猜测候选
scenarios.covered_by: missing critical profile fields asks for clarification without inventing a candidate

scenarios.expected: 预算低于同型号真实公开快照时标记待确认，reference 保持非交易报价
scenarios.covered_by: budget below the real same-model public snapshot is marked pending, never quoted

scenarios.expected: 无精确型号图片时降级纯文字；人为错绑图片触发 IMAGE_MODEL_MISMATCH
scenarios.covered_by: missing exact-model images downgrade to text and never substitute the other model; a deliberately misassigned harmony image is rejected for the 2024 model

scenarios.expected: 朋友圈图片上限收敛、未支持平台被输入契约拒绝
scenarios.covered_by: platform image limits and unsupported platform boundary are enforced

source_dimensions.prices: local_kb_index.json 内同型号 price_records；仅作预算核对快照，current_transaction_quote=false
source_dimensions.images: huawei-sales-agent-data/datasets/cleaned/image_review_registry.json；只有精确型号且 model_verified=true 的条目可进入审稿稿
source_dimensions.publication: 全部结果经 release-verification.js 六项门禁；图片授权未完成时从安全版本移除
